mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_agora ( parent_agora_number, root_agora_number, user_number, title, content, node_type, depth, status ) VALUES ( #{parentAgoraNumber}, #{rootAgoraNumber}, #{userNumber}, #{title}, #{content}, #{nodeType}, #{depth}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_agora SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE agora_number = #{agoraNumber}
mapper.select: SELECT a.agora_number, a.parent_agora_number, a.root_agora_number, a.user_number, a.title, a.content, a.node_type, a.depth, a.like_count, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, u.login_id, u.name, u.role, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_agora c WHERE c.root_agora_number = a.agora_number AND c.node_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS comment_count FROM tbl_agora a INNER JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_number = a.user_number WHERE a.node_type = 'POST' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.agora_number, a.parent_agora_number, a.root_agora_number, a.user_number, a.title, a.content, a.node_type, a.depth, a.like_count, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, u.login_id, u.name, u.role, CASE WHEN a.node_type = 'POST' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_agora c WHERE c.root_agora_number = a.agora_number AND c.node_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ELSE 0 END AS comment_count FROM tbl_agora a INNER JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_number = a.user_number WHERE a.agora_number = #{agoraNumber}

SELECT a.agora_number, a.parent_agora_number, a.root_agora_number, a.user_number, a.title, a.content, a.node_type, a.depth, a.like_count, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, u.login_id, u.name, u.role FROM tbl_agora a INNER JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_number = a.user_number WHERE a.root_agora_number = #{rootAgoraNumber} AND a.node_type = 'COMMENT' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.created_at ASC
